_comment: Stamp for the proposed/draft/deferred ADR review cadence (ADR 0140). `reviewed: null` = no review recorded yet; the clock runs from `installed`, and gate 9 (lint:adr-index) reds when the review is >30 days old or the `proposed` set drifts from the live corpus. To discharge: re-read each listed ADR against what is actually built, correct any Status header that has gone stale, then set `reviewed` to that date and `proposed` to the then-current set.
